item.title: The Story Of The Chernobyl Disaster And The Radioactive Ghost Town Of Pripyat It Left Behind
item.description: On April 26, 1986, a failure during a reactor systems test led to the meltdown of Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant in the Pripyat, Ukraine. It would become the worst nuclear disaster in history. The post The Story Of The Chernobyl Disaster And The Radioactive Ghost Town Of Pripyat It Left Behind appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.title: A Metal Detectorist In England Unearthed A Roman Figurine Depicting A Big Cat Pawing A Man’s Severed Head
item.description: Found in Harlow, Essex in 2024, this 1,800-year-old copper figure is believed to have been mounted to the strap that yoked a carriage to the animal that was pulling it. The post A Metal Detectorist In England Unearthed A Roman Figurine Depicting A Big Cat Pawing A Man’s Severed Head appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.title: New Study Uses Imaging Technology To Reveal Previously Unseen Graffiti And Love Messages On The Walls Of Pompeii
item.description: Researchers were able to pick up faint traces of graffiti, love notes, and more along a stretch of wall in Pompeii. The post New Study Uses Imaging Technology To Reveal Previously Unseen Graffiti And Love Messages On The Walls Of Pompeii appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.title: Meet Aimo Koivunen, The Soldier Who Survived WWII Thanks To Accidentally Overdosing On Meth
item.description: In 1944, Finnish soldier Aimo Koivunen got separated from his unit and survived for weeks inside the Arctic Circle without food or shelter — fueled by a dose of meth large enough for 30 men. The post Meet Aimo Koivunen, The Soldier Who Survived WWII Thanks To Accidentally Overdosing On Meth appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.description: Cheryl Bradshaw's Dating Game episode aired in September 1978, but it would be another year before anyone would learn Rodney Alcala was one of America's worst serial killers. item.title: Meet The Real Persian Royals Behind The Viral ‘Princess Qajar’ Memes
item.description: The legendary "Princess Qajar” is actually a conflation of two 19th-century Persian royals — Fatemeh Khanum "Esmat al-Dowleh" and Zahra Khanum "Taj al-Saltaneh.” The post Meet The Real Persian Royals Behind The Viral ‘Princess Qajar’ Memes appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.description: This mysterious concentration of iron has the mass of Mars and is longer than 463 million Earths lined up in a row. item.title: Scientists Have Captured Jaguars ‘Meowing’ For The First Time Ever
item.description: Scientists have long believed that most big cats can't meow, but cameras in Brazil's Iguaçu National Park have now recorded mother jaguars and their cubs making "meow-like" vocalizations. The post Scientists Have Captured Jaguars ‘Meowing’ For The First Time Ever appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.title: The Tragic Death Of Sean Bell, The Unarmed Black Man Who Was Fatally Shot By NYPD Officers On His Wedding Day
item.description: In the early morning hours of November 25, 2006, five plainclothes officers opened fire on Sean Bell's vehicle in Queens, fatally striking the 23-year-old, because they thought one of his friends had a weapon — but there was no gun in the car. The post The Tragic Death Of Sean Bell, The Unarmed Black Man Who Was Fatally Shot By NYPD Officers On His Wedding Day appeared first on All That's Interesting.
